# Local frontend assets

These upstream distributions are served by Django staticfiles. No Node build or
runtime CDN connection is required.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Oat UI | 0.8.0 | https://unpkg.com/@knadh/oat@0.8.0/ | MIT, included in oat/LICENSE |
| HTMX | 2.0.10 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.10/ | Zero-Clause BSD, included in htmx/LICENSE |

Oat CSS/JS installation: https://oat.ink/usage/
HTMX installation: https://htmx.org/docs/#installing

For an upgrade, select a specific upstream version, replace its distribution and
license files, update this record, and verify sign-in on desktop and mobile.
